title: Top Function
statement: Implement `solve(rows)`. `rows` is a list of `[name, time]` with integer times. Return the name with the largest time. Break ties by the name that is smaller. The list is non-empty.
hints: Replace on a higher time or an equal time with a smaller name.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Internal time in a profile is the column that names the function whose body burned CPU.

editorial: Internal time in a profile is the column that names the function whose body burned CPU. The maximum is the first place you look. A tie should be stable so two equal rows do not flap between runs of a report.
